en: But before we start, I want to ask you a couple of questions.

en: So first of all, how many of you took a photo or video during this conference?

en: Please raise your hands.

en: Not that many.

en: And to be honest, that was me.

speaker: Unknown
en: I was recording a lot of content during conferences, events, trips, meetups, and I never posted them online because video editing is hard.

en: And it also feels like an art and not really automated.
zh: 而且它感觉像是一门艺术，而不是真正自动化的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's why we're building RLFL and we're trying to tackle agentic video editing problem from the agentic standpoint.
zh: 这就是为什么我们在构建 RLFL，我们试图从智能体的角度来解决智能体视频剪辑问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm Kate, I'm founder and CEO at RLFL.
zh: 我是 Kate，RLFL 的创始人兼 CEO。

speaker: Unknown
en: But let's first talk about what agentic video editing is.
zh: 但我们先来谈谈什么是智能体视频剪辑。

speaker: Unknown
en: So as a user, you just drop in your media photos and videos and provide some context.
zh: 作为用户，你只需要把你的媒体文件——照片和视频——放进来，并提供一些上下文。

speaker: Unknown
en: It can be the context what happened in this media files or it can be some directions.
zh: 这个上下文可以是这些媒体文件里发生了什么，也可以是一些指令。

speaker: Unknown
en: For example, like add captions, add music, add voiceover and something like that.
zh: 比如，添加字幕、添加音乐、添加配音之类的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then the agent will go understand your media, find the right moments, assemble everything together, generate captions, music, voiceover, B-rolls, and give you a ready-to-share clip.
zh: 然后智能体会去理解你的媒体，找到合适的片段，把所有东西组装在一起，生成字幕、音乐、配音、B-roll，给你一个可以直接分享的片段。

speaker: Unknown
en: And yeah, so basically that's agentic video editing, so agent does everything by itself.
zh: 是的，基本上这就是智能体视频剪辑，智能体自己完成所有事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: Or another example, you recorded a speak-to-camera video and you have a lot of pauses, unsuccessful shots, and you expect an agent to figure it out to remove unsuccessful shots, remove pauses, and give you a ready-to-share clip.
zh: 再举一个例子，你录了一个对着镜头说话的视频，里面有很多停顿、不成功的镜头，你期望智能体自己搞明白，去掉不成功的镜头、去掉停顿，给你一个可以直接分享的片段。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the interesting thing is that a lot of, actually a lot of the things inside this pipeline can be automated.
zh: 而有趣的是，这条流水线里其实很多东西都可以自动化。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this is exactly what we're doing at RLHF.
zh: 而这正是我们在 RLHF 所做的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: Oh, this is the example of video edited.
zh: 哦，这是一个剪辑过的视频的例子。

speaker: Unknown
en: And since we're at AI Engineering Conference, I wanted to talk a little bit about infrastructure.
zh: 既然我们在 AI Engineering Conference，我想稍微谈谈基础设施。

speaker: Unknown
en: And from the infrastructure standpoint, Argentic Video Editor is very similar to Argentic App Builder.
zh: 从基础设施的角度来看，智能体视频编辑器和智能体应用构建器非常相似。

speaker: Unknown
en: Sorry, there is a typo on the slide.
zh: 抱歉，幻灯片上有个错别字。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the second column is Argentic Video Editor.
zh: 第二列是智能体视频编辑器。

speaker: Unknown
en: So both of them have a prompt
zh: 它们都有一个提示词

speaker: Unknown
en: A UI for prompt, and in the video editor case, it's a media plus prompt, and usually on backend, what's happening?
zh: 一个用于提示词的 UI，在视频编辑器的场景下，是媒体加提示词，通常在后端发生的是什么呢？

speaker: Unknown
en: There is a remote machine, which is called Sandbox, which is spinning up, and inside this machine, there is an agent with tools and skills, which is working on what you're asking it to do.
zh: 会启动一台远程机器，叫做沙箱，在这台机器里，有一个带着工具和技能的智能体，正在处理你要求它做的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: In the case of the Argentic app builder, it's a codebase.
zh: 在智能体应用构建器的场景下，它是代码库。

speaker: Unknown
en: In the case of the Argentic video editor, it's a video, video composition.
zh: 在智能体视频编辑器的场景下，它是视频、视频合成。

speaker: Unknown
en: And as a result, in the Argentic app builder, users get an app preview, and for the video editor, users get a rendered video.
zh: 最终，智能体应用构建器给用户的是应用预览，而视频编辑器给用户的是渲染好的视频。

speaker: Unknown
en: And, but yes, from infrastructural standpoint, it's pretty similar, but there are a couple of differences.
zh: 是的，从基础设施的角度来看，它们非常相似，但有几个不同之处。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this is actually the most interesting to me, generating versus editing.
zh: 这其实是我最感兴趣的地方：生成 versus 剪辑。

speaker: Unknown
en: At Reelful, we're focusing on editing real footage.
zh: 在 Reelful，我们专注于剪辑真实素材。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we do not generate a lot of content.
zh: 所以我们不生成大量内容。

speaker: Unknown
en: We are expecting you to provide your real life, your personal content, and we will edit it for you.
zh: 我们期望你提供你的真实生活、你的个人内容，然后我们为你剪辑。

speaker: Unknown
en: And actually, this is a more complex problem because if the agent has a blank canvas, it can do whatever they can.
zh: 而且实际上，这是一个更复杂的问题，因为如果智能体有一张空白画布，它可以想做什么就做什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: But in the editing case, the agent has to figure out which moments are the best.
zh: 但在剪辑的场景下，智能体必须搞清楚哪些片段是最好的。

speaker: Unknown
en: What to omit, what to use, how to organize everything together.
zh: 省略什么、用什么、如何把它们组织在一起。

speaker: Unknown
en: And also sometimes footage can be messy or incomplete and agent still has to deliver a very polished result professionally made so that ideally the viewers of this content don't get if it is like AI or human edited.
zh: 而且有时候素材可能是凌乱的或不完整的，智能体仍然要交付一个非常精致、专业制作的成果，理想情况下，观看这些内容的观众分辨不出它是 AI 剪的还是人剪的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So let's actually have a look how we do it at Reelful.
zh: 那我们来看看我们在 Reelful 是怎么做的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we start, as I already mentioned, with your media plus a prompt, some directions like how you want it to be edited, and we need to get a polished clip.
zh: 我们从，正如我已经提到的，你的媒体加提示词开始，一些指令比如你希望它怎么被剪辑，而我们需要产出一个精致的片段。

speaker: Unknown
en: So let's go through it step by step.
zh: 我们一步步来过一遍。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we are doing first media understanding.
zh: 我们首先做媒体理解。

speaker: Unknown
en: We need to understand what's actually happening on those clips and photos.
zh: 我们需要理解这些片段和照片上到底发生了什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we also need to transcribe speech, for example, in the case if you have speak-to-camera videos.
zh: 我们还需要转录语音，比如在你有对着镜头说话的视频的情况下。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then we are providing a creative plan for the user so that they can approve if they like it or not, what they want to change or maybe regenerate, and we create this plan before actually starting editing.
zh: 然后我们为用户提供一个创意方案，让他们可以批准是否喜欢、想改什么、或者可能重新生成，并且我们在真正开始剪辑之前创建这个方案。

speaker: Unknown
en: Once the user approved this plan, we spin up a sandbox, the remote machine that we already discussed, and this is an environment for the agent to execute everything.
zh: 用户批准这个方案后，我们启动一个沙箱，就是我们刚才讨论的那台远程机器，这是智能体执行所有事情的环境。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the agent comes with the skills, and in our case, in the case of video editing,
zh: 所以智能体自带技能，在我们的例子里，在视频编辑的情况下，

speaker: Unknown
en: Our skills are, for example, cut rules, how, for example, how to select the best moments, also font pairs, which fonts are more suitable for this use case, which are not, for example, how to generate B-rolls, and this is where taste and craft live, actually.
zh: 我们的技能比如有剪辑规则，比如如何挑选最佳片段，还有字体搭配，哪些字体更适合这个用例，哪些不适合，比如如何生成 B-roll,而这其实正是品味和手艺所在的地方。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then also agent can initiate some other sub processes, for example, generating music that will fit this exact composition, generating voiceover, adding sounds, animating images.
zh: 然后智能体还可以启动一些其他的子流程，比如生成适合这个具体构图的音乐、生成配音、添加音效、让图片动起来。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yes, this is actually what we do.
zh: 是的，这实际上就是我们在做的。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you provide photos, we can animate your photos to make them more dynamic and engaging.
zh: 如果你提供照片，我们可以让你的照片动起来，使它们更有动感、更吸引人。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then comes Remotion Composition.
zh: 接下来就是 Remotion Composition。

speaker: Unknown
en: So here a little bit of background.
zh: 这里先讲一点背景。

speaker: Unknown
en: What's Remotion?
zh: Remotion 是什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: Remotion is a framework, open source framework to create videos as code, as React code.
zh: Remotion 是一个框架，一个开源框架，用代码、用 React 代码来创建视频。

speaker: Unknown
en: So basically it's just like a file with the order with all your assets and tracks and how they're following each other.
zh: 基本上它就是一个文件，按顺序包含你所有的素材和轨道，以及它们如何相互衔接。

speaker: Unknown
en: Why it is important?
zh: 为什么这很重要？

speaker: Unknown
en: Because agents are really good at writing code, and therefore we can use them to create videos with this Remotion framework.
zh: 因为智能体非常擅长写代码，所以我们可以用它们通过这个 Remotion 框架来创建视频。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then the last thing is the verification layer.
zh: 然后最后一件事是验证层。

speaker: Unknown
en: Of course, agent can make mistakes, and that's why we developed this verification layer to make sure that all the composition is clean, is well-defined, everything will be rendered, and if there are some problems, then the agent will reiterate on the composition.
zh: 当然，智能体可能会犯错，这就是为什么我们开发了这个验证层，用来确保整个构图是干净的、定义良好的，所有内容都能被渲染出来，如果有一些问题，智能体就会对构图进行迭代。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this is how we got to a polished clip.
zh: 这就是我们最终得到一个精修过的剪辑的方式。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it's a lot, right?
zh: 所以这是一大堆东西，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: It's like a very complex workflow.
zh: 就像一个非常复杂的工作流。

speaker: Unknown
en: And ideally, we don't want our users to even know anything about it.
zh: 而理想情况下，我们甚至不想让我们的用户知道它的任何细节。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this is even maybe a bigger problem, how to deliver this complex agentic workflow to mass consumer.

speaker: Unknown
en: And this is how we're tackling that at Reelful.
zh: 这就是我们在 Reelful 解决这个问题的方式。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we decided to go mobile first so that users can edit videos while driving, walking, or maybe lifting weights.

speaker: Unknown
en: Also, I know that prompting videos can sometimes be also challenging.

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
en: For example,

speaker: Unknown

en: Or maybe you want to add B-rolls or voiceover so that users can just select these directional templates, drop their media, and that's it.

speaker: Unknown
en: Even without any prompt, it will work.

speaker: Unknown
en: And the third thing is a building editor.

speaker: Unknown
en: Why?

speaker: Unknown
en: Because we want to make this experience convenient and familiar for users.

speaker: Unknown
en: So a lot of people are already sort of using regular video editors, and that's why we want to provide this experience as well.
